operations.summary: Apply an approved partial or cumulative refund
operations.description: Requires a platform principal with billing.adjustments.manage and an explicit tenant_id. The core requires a matching unexpired, unused two-person approval fact; this endpoint neither creates nor weakens that approval. gross_amount_minor is the gross amount for this refund action.

params.name: Idempotency-Key
params.description: One bounded business-action key. Exact retries preserve the original payload, target, principal, and If-Match precondition. Reuse with changed input returns idempotency_conflict.

fields.name: approval_id
fields.description: Optional. Refunds no longer require a second administrator's approval. When supplied it must be a canonical UUID of an unexpired, unused manual approval for this order and operation; it is then validated and consumed as before. An empty string is treated as absent.

responses.description: Applied command result or identical committed replay.

fields.name: fulfillment
fields.description: Sanitized fulfillment reference. Billing transaction and balance-hold IDs are intentionally not exposed. Package fulfillment has a non-zero subscription_id plus both positive revisions and no traffic_grant_id; traffic fulfillment has a non-zero traffic_grant_id and no subscription fields. Before returning a command response, the implementation verifies the exact fulfillment, order, tenant, owner, subscription/grant IDs, and revisions against committed commerce facts. A mismatch is rejected.

operations.description: Requires a platform-scope principal. Empty optional parameters must be omitted; duplicate and unknown parameters are rejected. Product options include all sold products independent of filters, without a 100-item cap. Names come from the effective immutable product snapshot. User display IDs come from users.display_id. A subscription ID is its actual UUID, never its revision. Expiry week is the next 7 days; month is the next calendar month, both excluding already expired records. Expired includes ends_at equal to the query time. Status is the stored lifecycle status; an expired active subscription still has lifecycle_status active. Usage is currently null because the commerce read model has no authoritative settled per-cycle counter; unknown usage matches neither exhausted nor remaining. A traffic limit of -1 means unlimited. CNAME searches current and last-known-good hostname claims associated with the subscription or one of its sites. Search values are literal case-insensitive substrings, not SQL patterns.

params.name: status
params.type: string: all / enabled / disabled / active / cancelled

params.name: user_id
params.description: Exact owner UUID or positive decimal user display ID.

params.name: q
params.description: Literal substring of the package snapshot name or (when not all digits) of the subscription UUID; a positive decimal also matches the package display ID exactly.

responses.description: Globally filtered page with count and complete sold-product options.

operations.description: Executes all selected items in one transaction. The live session and RBAC are rechecked, including replay. A changed body under an existing key is rejected. Editing appends an entitlement snapshot without rewriting the purchased catalog version or historical prices. Enable/disable is independent of cancellation. Safe deletion rejects live resources; cascade deletion uses audited resource deletion and edge publication. Neither mode refunds money; unsettled orders, held balances and scheduled entitlements block deletion. Sync copies only selected fields to bound websites and L4 forwarding resources, then persists signed edge publication, rollout and node command outbox. Publication receipts are polled separately and command success does not imply every node has applied it.

fields.type: string: edit / enable / disable / delete / sync

operations.summary: List effective sold subscriptions for one explicit tenant
operations.description: Uses the fixed-time effective entitlement projection. Each subsequent page reuses all three values from the endpoint- and tenant-bound signed cursor, so later entitlement backfills, renewals, or cancellations cannot create mixed facts.

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Target tenant access-scope UUID; platform routes never infer it.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Versioned base64url HMAC-SHA256 envelope bound to endpoint, target tenant, and owner user where applicable. Tampering or cross-scope reuse returns package_commerce_validation_error.

params.name: status
params.description: Effective status at the frozen snapshot. active ends after snapshot_at; expired ends at or before snapshot_at; cancelled always follows the immutable cancelled lifecycle fact regardless of end_at.

params.name: end_at_from
params.description: Inclusive canonical UTC microsecond lower bound for end_at.

params.name: end_at_to
params.description: Exclusive canonical UTC microsecond upper bound for end_at.

params.name: include_product_name
params.description: Accepts exactly one lowercase true or false. Empty, repeated, or other values return 400. Omitted or false preserves the legacy response shape. true includes product_name only when the selected effective entitlement's immutable product_snapshot.name is a JSON string, preserved without normalization. Missing, null, or non-string names are omitted. The current product catalog is never used. This projection does not change subscription membership, ordering, or the cursor's tenant, owner, time, and high-water bounds.

responses.description: Stable effective-subscription projection page.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Present only in page-jump mode (tenant list).
